title: Cholas Dynasty
definition: The Imperial Cholas (c. 850–1279 CE) were a thalassocratic Tamil dynasty that established a centralized bureaucratic state, renowned for its sophisticated local self-government, maritime supremacy in the Indian Ocean, and monumental Dravidian temple architecture.
importanceInUpsc: A perennial favorite for Prelims (Art & Culture, Administration) and Mains (Governance, Maritime History, Temple Architecture).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Cholas Dynasty.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
